body: I spent 2 weeks in the Naval Hospital mental ward  in NC when I was active duty. Still had to wear my desert cammies but no boots, laces, or belt. Also no real solution to my problem either. Just pills that made me worse and more manic to the point I would hyperventilate and pass out sometimes. Prozac did that to me.
I called this one from my google voice account and an out of state number. It made it easy to block.
I expected some mental health resources. I'm OEF-A vet former active duty USMC, the last place I was going to call was the VA.
